reuse.why: Reuses the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection, isTrackingBudget and setBudget, and extracts setBulkBudgets so the new action and setBulkAverage share the loop; setZero still keeps its own copy of the loop and income rule.

duplication.why: The category loop and income-skip rule are shared, but the expense/income sign flip is written again in the new action (is_income === 1 ? x : -x) alongside setBulkAverage's own negation.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the new action; the setBulkAverage refactor is related extraction, though shouldBudgetCategory is a tiny wrapper and setZero is left half-migrated.

maintainability.why: A clear shared bulk-budget helper that future actions can use; minor issues are the odd indentation in the callbacks, the separate sign logic, and setZero not using the new helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getBulkBudgetCategories and the new setBulkBudgets; reads previous-month sum-amount from the sheet like getCategoryAverage does.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repeat is the explicit income/expense sign flip in setLastMonthSpending, written openly rather than disguised.
